new_jobs.title: Trade Operations Analyst
new_jobs.jd: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** KLA's Global Supply Chain (GSC) oversees sourcing, supplier contracting and management, materials management, direct and indirect procurement, and logistics and trade compliance. GSC leads activities to establish and manage an innovative, reliable, efficient, effective and compliant global supply chain and logistics structure that strengthens KLA's competitive advantage. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. **Trade Operations Leader, Taiwan** Role Profile | Trade Operations, Port Clearance, FTZ Execution **Location** Taiwan, with primary support for port clearance, manufacturing, service logistics, and regional trade operations. **Reports to** APAC Trade Operations Leader **Scope** End-to-end trade operations execution, including import/export clearance, customs broker governance, FTZ operations, duty and tax optimization, and operational controls. **Key Partners** Global Trade Compliance, Logistics, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Procurement, Finance, Customs Brokers, Freight Forwarders, and government authorities. **Success Outcome** A controlled, efficient, scalable, and audit-ready Taiwan trade operations environment that supports business continuity and cost optimization. Position Summary The Trade Operations Leader is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of import, export, customs, Foreign Trade Zone (FTZ), and trade operations activities across Taiwan. This role serves as the primary regional owner for trade execution, customs compliance support, broker management, duty optimization initiatives, and strategic trade programs. The position ensures compliant, efficient, and resilient cross-border movement of materials, spare parts, manufacturing equipment, and finished goods while supporting business continuity, cost optimization, and regulatory compliance objectives. Key Responsibilities Customs & Port Clearance Management * Own end-to-end import and export operations for Taiwan. * Ensure timely clearance of inbound and outbound shipments through Taiwan customs and port operations. * Manage relationships with customs brokers, freight forwarders, carriers, and government agencies. * Resolve customs holds, inspections, valuation issues, classification disputes, and documentation discrepancies. * Establish and maintain customs clearance procedures and broker operating instructions. * Monitor customs clearance performance, service levels, and escalation trends. * Lead escalation management for critical shipments impacting customer commitments or manufacturing operations. FTZ Operations & Governance * Serve as the designated business owner for Taiwan FTZ operations. * Ensure compliance with all FTZ regulations, operating procedures, and reporting requirements. * Oversee FTZ admissions, transfers, exports, inventory reconciliation, destruction, scrap, audits, and regulatory inspections. * Maintain inventory accuracy between physical inventory and system records. * Develop and implement FTZ operational controls and standard operating procedures. * Coordinate periodic reviews and internal audits of FTZ activities. Trade Operations Execution * Lead regional execution of trade operations activities across Taiwan. * Standardize processes for import management, export management, customs documentation, trade program administration, and broker management. * Ensure operational readiness for changes in trade regulations, tariffs, sanctions, and customs requirements. * Support regional business growth through scalable Trade Operations processes. Duty & Tax Optimization * Identify opportunities for FTZ utilization, duty reduction, tariff mitigation, tax optimization, and customs value management. * Partner with Global Trade Compliance and Finance to quantify and implement savings initiatives. * Support duty recovery and drawback opportunities where applicable. * Develop business cases for new trade programs and customs initiatives. Broker & Service Provider Management * Manage regional customs brokerage strategy and execution. * Establish broker scorecards and performance metrics. * Conduct quarterly business reviews with brokers and service providers. * Drive continuous improvement initiatives with logistics and customs partners. * Monitor service levels and compliance performance. Regulatory Compliance Support * Partner with Global Trade Compliance to ensure operational execution aligns with Taiwan customs regulations, export controls, import controls, free trade agreements, and government licensing requirements. * Support internal and external audits. * Maintain documentation supporting customs declarations and audits. * Assist with investigations related to customs inquiries and regulatory issues. Cross-Functional Leadership * Act as the Taiwan trade operations subject matter expert. * Collaborate with Manufacturing Operations, Logistics, Procurement, Customer Support, Supply Chain Planning, Finance, and Global Trade Compliance. * Lead projects involving new product introductions, facility expansions, FTZ activations, ERP enhancements, broker consolidations, and network optimization. Data Analytics & Continuous Improvement * Develop KPIs and dashboards to monitor customs clearance performance, broker effectiveness, duty spend, FTZ inventory accuracy, shipment cycle times, and compliance metrics. * Identify process improvement opportunities using Lean and continuous improvement methodologies. * Drive digital transformation and automation initiatives across trade operations processes. Key Performance Indicators * Customs clearance cycle time * Import/export on-time clearance rate * FTZ inventory accuracy * Customs audit findings * Broker performance scorecard * Duty and tax savings achieved * Trade compliance incident rate * Shipment hold resolution time * Operational cost reduction initiatives * Stakeholder satisfaction **Required Qualifications** Education * Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, International Business, Logistics, Customs Administration, Trade Compliance, Finance, or a related field. * Master's degree preferred. **Experience** * 10+ years of international trade, customs, logistics, or supply chain experience. * 5+ years of leadership experience. * Direct experience managing customs brokers and import/export operations in Taiwan. * Strong understanding of FTZ operations and inventory control requirements. * Experience supporting manufacturing and high-technology environments. * Experience working with customs authorities and government agencies. Technical Knowledge * Taiwan customs regulations * Import/export operations * FTZ management * Harmonized tariff classification * Customs valuation * Rules of origin * Duty optimization programs * SAP ERP / SAP GTS or equivalent systems * Customs broker management Leadership Competencies * Strategic thinking * Operational excellence * Stakeholder management * Regulatory risk management * Change leadership * Data-driven decision making * Influencing without authority * Executive communication * Continuous improvement mindset * Strong commercial acumen Reporting Structure * Reports to: APAC Trade Operations Leader * Typical direct reports may include Trade Operations Specialists, Import/Export Analysts, FTZ Administrator, and Trade Program Analyst, as applicable. Success Profile The successful candidate will create a highly controlled, efficient, and scalable trade operations environment that enables uninterrupted manufacturing and customer fulfillment while maximizing FTZ benefits,

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Director
new_jobs.jd: Company Description Crescendo Lab is building an AI Communication Cloud that helps enterprises connect customer communication, data, and AI across marketing, sales, and customer service. Our platform spans MAAC, CAAC, and DAAC, and our Agent Lab helps businesses design, deploy, and manage AI agents that understand business context, access enterprise data, use tools, and take action alongside human teams. Founded in Taiwan in 2017, Crescendo Lab supports 800+ brands across Asia and is expanding its AI-native enterprise stack across Taiwan, Japan, Thailand, Singapore, and beyond. Role Description The Product Director is a full-time, hybrid role based in the Taipei–Keelung Metropolitan area. This role owns product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Crescendo Lab’s AI Communication Cloud and Agent Lab, aligning product priorities with business goals and enterprise customer needs. You will lead product discovery and delivery, mentor product managers, collaborate with engineering, design, data, Sales, and Customer teams, and translate market and customer insight into clear product decisions. You will define success metrics, engage strategic customers and partners, and help turn AI, data, and integrations into measurable enterprise outcomes across Asia. Qualifications • Experience owning product strategy, vision, roadmap, and portfolio decisions for AI, B2B SaaS, or enterprise software. • Strong product discovery, research, analytics, prioritization, and lifecycle management skills. • Proven experience leading or mentoring product teams in a fast-moving technology environment. • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams. • Experience with enterprise platforms, customer engagement, messaging, marketing automation, data, or AI agents is a plus. • Comfortable working hybrid in Taipei–Keelung and collaborating across multiple Asian markets. • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

new_jobs.title: 【TW Life】Senior AI Project Manager, Transformation Dept.
new_jobs.jd: **Role Overview** **JOB DESCRIPTION** This role sits within the Technology Division's AI & Innovation Center and is responsible for leading end-to-end AI product strategy, requirements definition, and post-launch optimization. The Senior AI PM must be capable of independently driving large-scale AI initiatives, communicating product vision to C-level stakeholders, and possessing sufficient technical depth to co-design system architecture with AI engineers and data scientists. This role also owns the AI governance framework, ensuring AI decisions comply with regulatory requirements, ethical standards, and Chubb's business objectives. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead AI product roadmap development, integrating business strategy, technical feasibility, and regulatory requirements * Independently produce product specifications for complex AI systems — including multi-agent architectures, RAG systems, and workflow automation * Define the AI Observability Framework: design model drift detection mechanisms and incident response playbooks * Lead cross-functional AI programs (claims, underwriting, customer service), synthesizing requirements from business, legal, compliance, and IT * Design and implement A/B testing frameworks for AI features; build a data-driven product decision culture * Ensure AI products comply with relevant regulations (e.g., FSC, GDPR); lead AI ethics and fairness reviews * Coach and develop Junior PMs; build AI product capabilities across the product team * Present AI product progress, outcomes, and risks to senior leadership; influence the organization's AI investment decisions **Qualifications** **Education & Experience** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Statistics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred * 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years as the primary PM on AI/ML products **Technical Skills** * Deep understanding of LLM / Agentic AI architecture: RAG, Tool Calling, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning, Quantization * Ability to write product specifications for multi-agent systems — including agent collaboration, failure modes, and graceful degradation strategies * Fluent in interpreting AI performance metrics in business terms: Precision, Recall, Calibration, Drift Detection * Knowledge of AI ethics and regulatory requirements * Familiarity with MLOps concepts: model versioning, A/B testing, canary releases, model monitoring * Ability to perform basic data analysis with SQL to support product decisions **Personal Attributes** * Strong product ownership mindset; able to set clear direction and drive execution in ambiguous environments * Able to communicate complex AI concepts to C-level and business stakeholders without technical jargon * Data-driven decision habits; able to design measurable success criteria * Outstanding cross-functional and cross-cultural influencing skills; skilled at building consensus * Strong written and verbal communication in English; Chinese proficiency is a plus **Nice to Have** * Deep experience with AI products in insurance (claims, underwriting, actuarial) or financial services * Track record as PM on enterprise-scale AI systems (>100K users) * Experience designing AI governance frameworks or Responsible AI practices * Experience with AI-related regulatory submissions or regulator communications * Relevant certifications: CSPO, PMI-ACP, Google Professional ML Engineer, or equivalent * Familiarity with RPA (UiPath, Power Automate) and AI-integrated product design

Operating within a highly collaborative international environment, the organisation partners closely with healthcare professionals, policymakers, payers and patient communities to ensure innovative therapies reach the patients who need them most. Senior leaders are empowered to shape business strategy, influence healthcare access and contribute to both local and global initiatives. **Job Description** * Define and execute market access strategies that support optimal pricing, reimbursement and patient access outcomes across the portfolio. * Lead reimbursement planning, submission development and payer engagement activities to secure timely access for innovative therapies. * Provide strategic direction for pricing decisions throughout the product lifecycle, balancing commercial objectives with access considerations. * Oversee the creation of value dossiers, health economic evaluations, budget impact models and reimbursement evidence packages. * Identify access risks, evaluate opportunities and develop mitigation strategies to support sustainable growth. * Drive early access planning and ensure market access considerations are embedded into launch readiness and lifecycle management activities. * Provide leadership across supporting reimbursement and access objectives. * Lead the development and optimisation of patient affordability programmes, patient support initiatives and alternative access solutions where appropriate. * Monitor programme performance and implement improvements that enhance patient impact and organisational value. * Analyse healthcare policy developments, reimbursement reforms and market dynamics, providing strategic recommendations to senior leadership. * Develop productive relationships with key external stakeholders, healthcare decision makers, industry bodies and relevant policy groups. * Assess emerging funding mechanisms, innovative access models and partnership opportunities that may expand patient access. * Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Market Access team while strengthening organisational capability and succession pipelines. * Contribute as a key member of the country leadership team, supporting portfolio prioritisation, business planning and organisational decision making. * Collaborate extensively with regional and global colleagues to share market insights and leverage international best practices. **The Successful Applicant** * Advanced degree in pharmacy, life sciences, public health, economics, health economics, business or a related discipline. * Significant leadership experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare industry. * Proven expertise in pricing, reimbursement, payer engagement and market access strategy. * Strong understanding of Taiwan's healthcare environment, reimbursement pathways and
